text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
...Geez~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(So frustrating! So frustrating!!
This was the real race, and yet
I couldn't focus at all!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(And it was my chance to find magic, too!
I'm way more frustrated than I am having fun...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Seriously, the worst...!)

After the race, Sweep Tosho was considerably
irritated. Her silent, oppressive aura pierced through the air.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho-san!
Sorry to bother you when you must be tired,
but could we have just a quick word?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't decide for me!!
I'll decide for myself!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...! W-Whoa, hold on...
Would it be better to reschedule this interview?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll listen. What's the question?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then if you don't mind,
may I ask what your next target race is for Sweep-san?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
………………
……The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

The race she named was a Junior-tier GⅠ
held at Hanshin Racecourse.
It's a mile race, perfectly suited to her running style.
choice_data_list: (...I wonder if she looked into this thoroughly.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Eh, jumping straight to a GⅠ!?
That's quite an ambitious challenge...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, she's at that age where she wants to act tough.
Still, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I know this is your first interview, but at times like this, you should answer with more than just single words and be a bit more welcoming.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Talking openly, brightly, and energetically
is what makes you truly adorable, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ……Aaaaargh……!!
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Who is it, at a time like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sweepy!
Make sure you get plenty of rest today!
Resist the urge to stay up late—

(Click...!
Beep, beep...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geeeeez!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Every last one of them, nagging me from morning till night to do this and do that! Shut up already!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I've had it! No way!
I'm not running in the race either, so just leave me alone!!"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
U-Um~... Sweep-san.
Don't you think it's about time to head home...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going back, I won't!!
I'm not taking a single step away from here!

She stubbornly held out after that,
remaining completely frozen. Then, gradually,
her eyelids closed, and she drifted off to sleep.

...Facing the major challenge of how to interact with her moving forward,
I ponder our next objective.
choice_data_list: If I remember correctly, you wanted to run in the Hanshin JF, right?
If I remember correctly, you wanted to run in the Hanshin JF, right?

text_block_list.text:
...I decided to set our immediate goal as the
'Hanshin JF,' which she had mentioned earlier.
